Every exam guide in the current official AWS index, including overlapping current and announced replacement versions while each remains schedulable or publicly documented for launch.

Tech+, both independently published A+ V15 component exams, Network+, Security+, Linux+, and Cloud+ using each current exact exam page.
The selected first wave of LFCA, LFCS, CKA, CKAD, and CKS; bundles, translated duplicates, and unrelated catalog products are excluded.

The seven agreed foundational, associate, and professional expansion anchors plus Professional Agentic Architect while its public beta contract is active; Google Workspace, database, developer, DevOps, network, security-operations, and data-practitioner certifications remain future breadth candidates.

The agreed first Cisco expansion: CCST Networking, CCST Cybersecurity, CCNA, and CCNA Automation. Adjacent support-technician, cybersecurity, professional, specialist, and expert credentials remain future breadth candidates.

The agreed Snowflake expansion: preserve the retired SOL-C01 Associate page and its non-certification Platform Skills Badge replacement, then cover current COF-C03 Core, DEA-C02 Advanced Data Engineer, and GES-C02 Gen AI. Retired COF-C02 and GES-C01 are excluded as current targets.

The agreed ISC2 expansion: entry-level CC, practitioner SSCP, cloud-specialist CCSP, and broad senior-practitioner CISSP. Passing an exam is kept separate from each credential's experience, endorsement, membership, ethics, and continuing-education requirements.

The agreed NVIDIA expansion: associate Generative AI LLMs and AI Infrastructure and Operations, followed by professional AI Operations with its integrated hands-on labs. Other active and coming-soon NVIDIA credentials remain future breadth candidates.

The agreed Salesforce expansion: current Platform Administrator, Platform App Builder, Platform Developer, and Agentforce Specialist credentials. Salesforce's seasonal exam releases and annual maintenance requirements are tracked independently from the stable credential names.

The agreed MongoDB expansion: Associate Developer, Associate Data Modeler, and Associate Atlas Administrator. The current self-managed Associate Database Administrator remains future breadth. Detailed study guides are free after enrollment; public exam contracts and learning paths remain separately monitored.

The agreed first ServiceNow expansion: the foundational Certified System Administrator and platform-development Certified Application Developer mainline credentials. Product-specific Implementation Specialist, micro-certification, accreditation, and expert-program credentials remain future breadth. Current public blueprint knowledge articles are required; official training and MeasureUp practice access are recorded separately.

The September 2, 2026 public role-based portfolio contains two shared foundational certifications plus Network Security, Security Operations, and Cloud Security professional, specialist, and architect credentials. Inventory all 17 current titles, and use Cybersecurity Apprentice as the first public-datasheet pilot. Legacy PCCET, PCNSA, PCNSE, and other retired product-era exams are not current targets.

The September 2, 2026 post-transition portfolio has 19 current certifications: NSE 1 through NSE 4, four solution-track certifications at each of NSE 5, NSE 6, and NSE 7, NSE 8 Cybersecurity Expert, plus MSSP Security and OT Security industry certifications. Inventory certifications rather than every versioned product exam. Use NSE 4 FortiOS as the first guide because its public FortiOS 7.6 Administrator page exposes a complete weighted exam topic table. FCF, FCA, FCP, FCSS, and FCX remain historical credentials after the July 15, 2026 transition, not parallel current targets.

The September 2, 2026 live catalog displays 14 certification tracks: 11 current platform, observability, and cyber-defense titles plus three explicitly labeled Legacy. Retain the legacy ES Admin, ITSI Admin, and SOAR Automation Developer records as retired context rather than active targets. Cybersecurity Defense Architect remains beta/change-sensitive because Splunk staff said beta performance results were still targeted for the latter half of 2026 even though the public page now shows normal pricing. Use Cybersecurity Defense Analyst as the first detailed public-blueprint pilot.

The agreed governance, audit, and risk expansion: CISA, CISM, and CRISC. Inventory the active certifications and preserve their exam-versus-certification experience, application, maintenance, and scheduled-outline boundaries. Other ISACA certifications and certificate programs remain future breadth candidates.

All ten exam versions shown as active or active in a small-market trial on September 2, 2026 across the general-purpose programming, data science, testing, security, automation, and artificial-intelligence tracks. In-development PCEP-30-03, PCAP-31-04, PCPP-32-102, PCPP2, PCPT, PCAS, PCAA, PCAI, PCEW, and PCAW are watch items rather than current inventory rows. Discontinued PCED-30-01 and PCAD-31-01 are excluded.

All six C++ Institute exams displayed as active September 2, 2026: the entry, associate, and professional levels of the independent C and C++ tracks. Retired exam versions are excluded; the catalog says current credentials are lifetime and preserve the completed exam version.

All four JS Institute exams displayed as active September 2, 2026: entry and associate general-purpose JavaScript programming plus entry and associate HTML/CSS web development. Course-completion certificates are excluded.

The five live Microsoft 365 Apps Word, Excel, and PowerPoint Associate/Expert exams selected September 4, 2026. MO-410 Outlook remains coming soon; Office 2019 versions and job-specific Excel credentials remain future inventory rather than duplicate current-version guides.

Six live single-exam IBM anchors verified September 4, 2026: Artificial Intelligence Fundamentals, watsonx Generative AI Engineer, QRadar SIEM Associate and Administrator, Guardium Data Protection Administrator, and Db2 13 for z/OS Database Administrator Associate. IBM's broader product catalog and composite PLUS credentials remain future breadth.

The current Java SE 21 Developer Professional exam exposed by Oracle University's public learning path. This is a one-guide pilot, not a claim that the broad OCI, database, Java, applications, and hardware catalog is fully inventoried.

Six current English Oracle University learning paths selected September 4, 2026: OCI 2026 Foundations, Architect Associate, Cloud Operations Professional, and Security Professional plus the current Oracle AI Database SQL and Administration associates. Superseded 2025 OCI paths carrying September 30, 2026 archive notices are excluded; the remaining specialist, professional, multicloud, MySQL, applications, and hardware catalogs remain future breadth.

Five current English 2026 Oracle University professional paths selected September 4, 2026: OCI Architect, Developer, DevOps, Networking, and Observability. The current Networking path and exam identify 2026 while one path-description sentence still names 2025; that inconsistency is retained as a verification warning.
